audit.whatIsWrong: The level chart gave Gangplank rows 2, 3, 4-5 and 2+ items while every why-string on the same rows explains why Ziggs wins them, and the packet chart plus the already-audited mirror both say Ziggs.
audit.why: Packet levelChart is Ziggs, Ziggs, Ziggs, Ziggs, Ziggs, Gangplank, Ziggs on 11 games at 81.82% win rate, and the mirror (gangplank__ziggs) set both of its layers to that same chart. Leaving my side unflipped would have the two directions disagree.
audit.corrected: Rows 1, 2, 3 and 6 flip to Ziggs on both layers as one atomic group; row 5 stays Gangplank, and its why is rewritten to actually justify Gangplank rather than describing a Ziggs spike.

audit.whatIsWrong: First item was described as your Blackfire Torch spike on a row the chart hands to Gangplank.
audit.why: His first-item window is Sheen into Trinity: barrel chains plus Parrrley. Cannon Barrage is 160/140/120s and effectively global (30000 range); Remove Scurvy is 22/20/18/16/14s at 400 range; Parrrley is a flat 4.5s at 625; Powder Keg has no cooldown cost on cast at 1000 range. Your own Satchel Charge is 20s at rank 1 and Mega Inferno Bomb 120s.
audit.corrected: phases[5].why now names the Sheen/Trinity window as his.

audit.whatIsWrong: The range advantage was stated vaguely, Remove Scurvy's sustain was absent, and Cannon Barrage's true damage was absent.
audit.why: Bouncing Bomb is 850 against Parrrley's 625 — a real 225-unit gap, unlike most poke claims. Remove Scurvy cures crowd control and restores health on a 22s cooldown at rank 1, which is what makes Grievous Wounds timing decide extended trades. Cannon Barrage deals true damage, so stacking MR against him is the wrong lever.
audit.corrected: Range numbers, the anti-heal requirement and the true-damage note are written into early, mid and spikes[0].text.

audit.whatIsWrong: Text asserted that dropping Hexplosive Minefield on his barrels detonates them.
audit.why: Whether mine contact destroys or detonates a Powder Keg is not in Riot's text and I could not verify it. The mirror flagged the same claim as unverified.
audit.corrected: Rewritten to the verifiable version — mines deny him the ground he needs to stand on to set a chain — rather than claiming the mines pop the keg.

edits.before: Blackfire Torch spike — your Q chunks become unhealable burn chip. Gangplank now chooses between farm and HP every wave.
edits.after: Sheen into Trinity is his one window: barrel chains plus crit Parrrley reach into your range. Clear kegs before they chain.

edits.before: Gangplank has no gap-closer and his Parrrley (Q) is out-ranged by your Bouncing Bomb (Q), so poke him on every step-up to CS. Drop Hexplosive Minefield (E) on his barrels to detonate them early and deny the gold he needs to scale.
edits.after: Parrrley is 625 to your 850, and he has no gap-closer — poke him on every step-up to CS. Remove Scurvy (W) heals and cures CC on a 22s cooldown at rank 1, so buy Grievous Wounds early or your chip just refunds itself.

edits.before: Through levels 3-6 you keep out-ranging him and shoving him off the wave. His Cannon Barrage (R) is global utility but can't save him in a 1v1 — just respect it being used to zone you off objectives or set up a gank.
edits.after: Through 3-6 you out-range him at 850 to 625 and shove him off the wave. Cannon Barrage (R) deals true damage, so no amount of MR blunts it — 160s at rank 1, and he uses it to zone you off objectives or set up a gank.

edits.before: Gangplank has no gap-closer and relies on Parrrley (Q) crits to trade — but your Bouncing Bomb (Q) out-ranges his Q, so poke him every time he steps to last-hit. Drop Hexplosive Minefield (E) on his barrels so you detonate them early or force him off the wave; deny his gold and he falls apart.
edits.after: Gangplank has no gap-closer and Parrrley (Q) reaches 625 to your 850, so poke him every time he steps to last-hit — Parrrley gold is how he reaches his item spikes, and denying it delays them. Drop Hexplosive Minefield (E) on the keg he wants to walk to so he cannot set the chain up safely.

notes: Both packet suspect names ('Drop Hexplosive Minefield', 'His Cannon Barrage') are false positives — the real names are intact, the matcher caught the preceding word. Still unverified and therefore untouched elsewhere: whether Hexplosive Minefield mines destroy or detonate a Powder Keg, and whether Satchel Charge's self-knockback can pull you out of a Cannon Barrage zone. Neither is answerable from Riot's text.
